title: First Time On The Court
style: warm acoustic pop, 88 BPM, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft piano, gentle male vocal, communal handclaps, tender storytelling, golden hour, hopeful nostalgia
lyrics:
[Intro]
First time on the court
Didn't know what a kitchen was

[Verse 1]
Borrowed paddle, borrowed shoes
Nothing left to win, nothing left to lose
Watched a video on my phone last night
Thought I knew the rules, oh I was not right

[Pre-Chorus]
Stepped to the line and I served too long
Stepped to the line and I served too strong
Hit the fence on the second try
Everybody clapped and I don't know why

[Chorus]
First time on the court, sun was going down
Strangers becoming the kindest crowd
First time on the court, I was free at last
Forty years of waiting just blew right past
First time on the court

[Verse 2]
She said good shot when it wasn't
He said try again like he meant it, didn't he
By the seventh point I forgot my name
By the eleventh point I just loved the game

[Pre-Chorus]
Sweat in my eyes and a smile too wide
Knees getting old but my heart's alive
The ball doesn't care how slow I go
Soft hands, soft hands, just let it flow

[Chorus]
First time on the court, sun was going down
Strangers becoming the kindest crowd
First time on the court, I was free at last
Forty years of waiting just blew right past
First time on the court

[Bridge]
You don't have to be good
You just have to show up
With a paddle in your hand
And a yellow plastic cup of nerves

[Outro]
First time on the court
Won't be the last
